history.prompt:
Create an original publication-quality technical explanatory illustration as a no-text PNG. The supplied external images are mechanism references only: independently design a fresh composition, never imitate their layout or typography. Use a pure white canvas (transparent is acceptable only if it composites as pure white), thin muted graphite flow arrows, flat 2D orthographic shapes, smooth solid pale fills. Palette: cyan input (#4DBBD5), green processing (#00A087), warm orange pooling (#F39B7F), muted blue representations (#3C5488), red output/gradients (#E64B35), neutral gray supporting parts. Colors at low opacity for large areas, stronger outlines and small accents. Balance white modules with selectively pale colored groups, one dominant color per semantic group. Same semantic modules share treatment; adjacent unlike semantics have different color. No glossy icon tiles, no card dashboard, no thick title bars, no decorative 3D, no perspective side faces, no extruded tensors, no shadow, glow, blur, gradient, texture, paper grain, noise, ripple, stripe or watermark. Mechanism marks (flat grids, feature-map thumbnails, small nodes, pooling cells) must carry scientific information rather than decorative icons. Optional decorative icons at most one per group; preferably none for operator diagrams. Avoid excessive boxes around everything. Reserve generous blank title and adjacent numeric annotation areas for later real-font typesetting. ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, letters, digits, equations, operation symbols, pseudo-glyphs, placeholder scribbles or watermark. All labels and math will be added later. A handwritten specimen inside an input image is an allowed visual sample, not a printed label. Arrowheads are required at actual destinations, no disconnected stubs or unexplained edges.

Scientific brief:
Explain a compact convolutional encoder-decoder with TWO same-scale skip concatenations, flat multiscale illustration with aligned encoder and decoder at each spatial scale. Input full resolution → first encoder feature full scale with 32 channels → second encoder half-scale with64 → bottleneck quarter-scale128. Decode: first upsample restores half-scale but retains128, then CONCATENATE with half-scale encoder64 producing192, then conv fusion yields64; second upsample restores full-scale retaining64, CONCATENATE with full-scale encoder32 producing96, conv fusion yields32; 1-by-1 task output full-scale. Skip connections only same spatial scale and enter concat AFTER upsampling BEFORE fusion. Use concat as distinct flat channel-join graphics, NO addition circles or plus signs. Show the upsampled maps, channel-concat strips and fusion kernels so it is more than box architecture. Naturally U/step spatial layout allowed but choose fresh composition from mechanism, not reference layout. Flat frontal feature grids, no3D. Blank group titles and shape annotations for all key steps, full line for192/96 concat math added later.

Revise THIS newly generated encoder-decoder draft only. Exact wiring correction: lower decoder concat receives the HALF-SCALE encoder feature directly at its left port, and first bottleneck-upsampled feature at its bottom port. Do not connect the half-scale skip into the upsampled feature before concat. Lower concat → lower convolution-fusion operator → lower decoded feature tensor. From THIS LOWER DECODED FEATURE, route an arrow back to the upper upsampling operator, then to upper concat bottom port. Currently upsampling incorrectly branches from concat before convolution; remove that shortcut. Upper concat receives full-scale encoder skip at its left port; then upper concat → upper convolution → upper decoded tensor → output. Keep two concat regions, two decoder convolutions and two upsample operators. No circles or plus symbols: concat clearly joins channels. Replace angled feature slabs with strictly frontal flat thumbnails, no 3D sides. No text/digits/formulas; leave blank titles/dimensions and white canvas with smooth pale solids.

source_audit.caption: 用于分割或着色的三尺度编码器—解码器。长方体表示特征张量，标签给出空间尺寸和通道数。每级解码先上采样到下一尺度，再由圆形$+$沿通道拼接同尺度的编码特征，随后卷积融合；上方旁路均接入拼接节点。图中上采样保持通道数，因此两次拼接分别得到$128+64=192$和$64+32=96$个通道，卷积后变为64和32个。输出头产生$q$个类别得分或两个颜色通道；采用same卷积，省略原始U-Net的裁剪。
source_audit.label: fig:cnn-encoder-decoder
source_audit.title: 三尺度CNN编码器解码器与跳跃拼接
source_audit.reason: 多阶段机制、并行/反馈路径、密集层次或多任务架构，超出少量节点/规则格表的简单图
source_audit.mechanism_brief: 编码器逐尺度降低空间、增加通道。解码时先上采样保持通道，再与同空间编码特征沿通道拼接，卷积融合。两次concat为128+64=192和64+32=96，卷积后分别回64/32，最后任务输出恢复空间。
must_preserve: 图中旧圆+实际语义为concat，重绘应改为明确拼接符号
跳跃只能同尺度，不能接到上采样之前。
